mapper.delete: DELETE FROM `message` WHERE `id` NOT IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT `id` FROM `message` ORDER BY `id` DESC LIMIT 50) t)
mapper.select: select `id`,`username`,`display_name`,`role`,`status`,`theme`,date_format(`create_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from `users` order by `status`,`id`
select `id`,`user_id`,`name`,`access_token`,date_format(`create_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from `ding_robot` where `user_id`=#{userId} order by `id`

select g.`id`, g.`name`, g.`owner_id` as ownerId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`display_name`,''), u.`username`) as ownerName, (select count(1) from `group_member` m where m.`group_id`=g.`id`) as memberCount from `group_chat` g join `group_member` mm on mm.`group_id`=g.`id` and mm.`user_id`=#{userId} left join `users` u on g.`owner_id`=u.`id` order by g.`id` desc

select g.`id`, g.`name`, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`display_name`,''), u.`username`) as ownerName, (select count(1) from `group_member` m where m.`group_id`=g.`id`) as memberCount, (select count(1) from `group_member` m2 where m2.`group_id`=g.`id` and m2.`user_id`=#{userId}) as joined, (select count(1) from `group_join_apply` a where a.`group_id`=g.`id` and a.`user_id`=#{userId} and a.`status`=0) as applying from `group_chat` g left join `users` u on g.`owner_id`=u.`id` where g.`name` like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') order by g.`id` desc limit 50

select m.`user_id` as userId, m.`role`, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`display_name`,''), u.`username`) as name from `group_member` m left join `users` u on m.`user_id`=u.`id` where m.`group_id`=#{groupId} order by m.`id`

select u.`id`, u.`username`, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`display_name`,''), u.`username`) as name, (select count(1) from `group_member` m where m.`group_id`=#{groupId} and m.`user_id`=u.`id`) as joined from `users` u where u.`status`=0 and (u.`username` like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or u.`display_name` like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) order by u.`id` limit 20
select `id`,`group_id` as groupId,`user_id` as userId,`status` from `group_join_apply` where `id`=#{applyId}
select count(1) from `group_join_apply` where `group_id`=#{groupId} and `user_id`=#{userId} and `status`=0

select a.`id`, a.`group_id` as groupId, g.`name` as groupName, a.`user_id` as userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`display_name`,''), u.`username`) as name, a.`reason`, date_format(a.`apply_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as "applyTime" from `group_join_apply` a join `group_chat` g on a.`group_id`=g.`id` and g.`owner_id`=#{ownerId} left join `users` u on a.`user_id`=u.`id` where a.`status`=0 order by a.`id` desc

select t.`id`, t.`msg_id` as msgId, t.`group_id` as groupId, t.`from_user_id` as fromUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`display_name`,''), u.`username`) as fromName, t.`msg_type` as msgType, t.`content`, date_format(t.`send_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as "time" from `group_msg_transit` t left join `users` u on t.`from_user_id`=u.`id` where t.`to_user_id`=#{userId} order by t.`id` for update

select m.`id` as msgId, m.`read_total` as total, (select count(1) from `group_msg_read` r where r.`msg_id`=m.`id`) as readCount from `group_msg` m where m.`group_id`=#{groupId} and m.`from_user_id`=#{userId} and m.`expire_time` > now() order by m.`id` desc limit 200

select r.`user_id` as userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`display_name`,''), u.`username`) as name, date_format(r.`read_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as "readTime" from `group_msg_read` r join `group_msg` m on m.`id`=r.`msg_id` and m.`from_user_id`=#{userId} left join `users` u on r.`user_id`=u.`id` where r.`msg_id`=#{msgId} order by r.`read_time`
select `menu_key` as menuKey, `visible`, `user_ids` as userIds from `menu_config`
mapper.insert: insert into `menu_config` (`menu_key`,`visible`,`user_ids`) values (#{menuKey},#{visible},#{userIds}) on duplicate key update `visible`=#{visible}, `user_ids`=#{userIds}
